items.text: Eagles officially ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday in London vs Jaguars; one of five players ruled out.
items.why: Hamstring injury; official Friday injury report confirmation.
items.implication: Eagles backfield opens fully; expect heavy backup usage in London game.
items.opportunity: Full RB opportunity shift to remaining backs/handcuffs.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) officially ruled out for Sunday vs Jaguars in London alongside Barkley.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed on final injury report.
items.implication: Increased target share for remaining Eagles pass-catchers including Goedert if active.

items.text: Commanders WR Stefon Diggs out (hamstring) vs Giants; QB Jayden Daniels will start and is good to go. Terry McLaurin trending positively.
items.why: Coach Quinn confirmation on Diggs out; Daniels cleared/starts.
items.implication: Daniels starts with reduced WR corps; McLaurin upgrade if full, more short targets elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Target bump for McLaurin and secondary options if Diggs sits.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson ruled out for Sunday night at Atlanta with left ankle injury; Tyler Huntley to start. Also ruled out Trey Hendrickson and Cam Jurgens.
items.why: Ankle injury from Week 4; official Friday ruling by coach/team and Schefter.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade for Ravens; Huntley start limits upside for pass-catchers in tough matchup.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) ruled out for Sunday vs Browns; missed practice and prior week as well. Braelon Allen expected to lead backfield.
items.why: Quadriceps; coach confirmation and multiple reports of DNP/out.
items.implication: Allen inherits primary carries/targets again; Hall week-to-week.
items.opportunity: Near-full snap/carry share for backup RB.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including OT Joe Alt and S Derwin James) for Week 5.
items.implication: More targets funneled to Ladd McConkey and remaining Chargers WRs.
items.opportunity: Route/target share increase for McConkey et al.

items.text: Broncos placing WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR with ankle injury from Week 4; will miss next four games, eligible to return Nov 8 vs Panthers.
items.why: Ankle; source confirmation for short-term IR.
items.implication: Broncos WR depth thins; opportunity for other receivers in DEN offense.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty listed as questionable on Friday injury report ahead of vs Patriots.
items.implication: Monitor for game-time; potential reduced role or sit if limited further.
items.opportunity: If out, backup RB opportunity expands.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) has no injury designation for Sunday at Green Bay after missing some practice; Kyle Monangai ruled out. Caleb Williams returned to practice (next week possible).
items.why: No designation for Swift; Williams practiced Friday.
items.implication: Swift expected full role; Monangai absence consolidates backfield. Williams eyeing Week 6.

items.text: Vikings listing both Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) as questionable for Sunday vs Saints.
items.implication: Game-time decisions; if either/both sit, massive target vacuum in MIN offense.
items.opportunity: If out, other WRs/TEs see expanded routes/targets.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love limited in practice for ankle 'maintenance' but not on final injury report and says full-go. Tough projection spot after Week 4 usage criticism; ETR still has Love 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier.
items.why: Not on final report; media/fan pressure may boost usage, but long-year fatigue risk vs Tyler Allgeier.
items.implication: Love remains clear lead in ETR DK projections despite uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded role if coaches respond to criticism.

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk stack for Malik Nabers long-term: sore knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, and coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) tendencies; notes frustration over low second-half targets. Still expects him to play this week.
items.why: Knee/shoulder/QB/coaching stack plus usage frustration; xFP and injury variance emphasis.
items.implication: Elevated long-term risk despite short-term play expectation; monitor practice/usage closely.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins vs Titans as his WR8; strong volume including red zone against a defense struggling vs WRs.

Berry loves Chase Brown as RB5 vs MIA (workload + Bengals injury context); also loves Michael Wilson WR10, Christian Watson WR15, Isaiah Likely TE5, Goff/Stafford/Dak. Hates Jordan Addison WR41, Mark Andrews TE17, Cam Skattebo RB20, Tony Pollard RB28, Jalen Hurts QB15 (rough stretch/banged line).
items.why: Volume/matchups for loves; tough matchups/roles/efficiency/game script for hates. If Breece out, Allen top-20 RB.
items.opportunity: Brown benefits from CIN WR uncertainty; Warren if Dowdle out.
